# Tineco US Official Store

> > Tineco's official e-commerce platform offering intelligent wet/dry vacuums and cordless cleaners with advanced self-cleaning and smart sensor technologies.

Tineco US Store is the primary retail destination for Tineco's full range of floor cleaning solutions, featuring flagship wet/dry vacuum models like the FLOOR ONE series and cordless alternatives. The store emphasizes smart cleaning technology, self-cleaning systems, and specialized features like steam mopping and anti-tangle designs.

## Key Topics

- Tineco FLOOR ONE series
- Wet/dry vacuum cleaners
- Cordless vacuum technology
- iLoop Smart Sensor Technology
- Self-cleaning systems (FlashDry, HyperSteam)
- DualBlock Anti-Tangle Design
- Steam mopping capabilities
- PURE ONE S11
- iFLOOR 5 Breeze
- Lay-flat design
- Pet hair removal
- Smart cleaning automation
- Extended runtime batteries
- HEPA filtration
- Multi-function wet/dry systems
